purpose: Turn highest-value HYP-130 capacity gaps into handable intervention packets — prototype local economic infrastructure, not merely a school project.

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW_vocabulary.label: Existing authority — can begin without new legislation

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW_rule: Every intervention packet must classify startability honestly so an Arkansas administration can see what is executable now versus what requires law, amendment, or federal permission.

packets.title: Rural Agriculture Magnet Hub — local economic infrastructure prototype

need.summary: Build local capability in agriculture, food systems, skilled trades, and introductory tech so rural communities own more of their economic infrastructure rather than exporting youth and importing scarce skills.

local_institution.primary: Public school district hosting agriculture magnet + CTE

pilot_geography.rule: One school district, town, or county with matched comparable-community controls (HYP-128)

likely: LEARNS-compatible school program design (legal memo required)

near_term_candidates: USDA Community Facilities / local food programs

partners: Local clinic / CHW pathway partners (allied, not UAMS replacement)

ownership_model.near_term: Public school + partner MOUs; community greenhouse/farm use agreements
ownership_model.medium_term_layer2: Pathway to cooperative food network / local grocery / community capital pools (separate packets)
ownership_model.not: Privatizing the school or creating partisan civic gatekeeping

candidates: local food production / processing training hours
graduate retention in county (survey — method NEE)
ownership starts or co-op memberships (Layer-2 linkage)

known_research_items: Magnet / CTE authority boundaries under LEARNS
Facility ownership and USDA eligibility for school-linked community facilities
Student labor / apprenticeship age and liability rules
Food processing and cottage-food / commercial kitchen compliance

pilot.definition: Single-site magnet hub program under existing authority with pre-registered outcomes
pilot.branding_rule: Investigative / implementation pilot — not proof that Constitutional Capitalism is validated

failure_conditions: Outcomes not measured or inventing success metrics
Program becomes partisan civic gate or rights-conditioned participation
School farm remains isolated activity with no workforce/ownership pathway
Dependency on a single unrenewed grant with no local ownership path

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW.explanation: Core magnet/CTE/apprenticeship configuration is hypothesized to begin under existing Arkansas school and workforce authorities with administrative partnerships. Facility and USDA food-system components often depend on federal program eligibility. Constitutional amendment is not required to start the school-centered prototype. Full legal memo still NEE before claiming authority is settled.
blocking_items_before_launch: at least one verified funding eligibility path

shared_dial_measurement_language.rule: Use only comparable dials when claiming cross-system or cross-community measurement parity

packets.title: Magnet-attached skilled trades / apprenticeship pipeline

need.summary: Close leave-state and leave-county patterns for trades Arkansas employers need by attaching Registered Apprenticeship to the hub.

local_institution.primary: School CTE + employer apprenticeship sponsor + two-year college

pilot_geography.rule: Same pilot geography as magnet hub or adjacent feeder

ownership_model.near_term: Employer-sponsored apprenticeship; school as related-instruction site

pilot.definition: One trade cohort attached to hub employers

failure_conditions: Classroom-only CTE with no employer sponsor

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW.explanation: Apprenticeship sponsorship and WIOA alignment are primarily administrative under existing federal/state frameworks. Not a constitutional amendment path.

packets.title: Rural allied / primary-care pathway attached to hub (not medical school substitute)

need.summary: Use HPSA shortage signal to build local allied-health and community-health pipelines while leave-state residency questions remain NEE.

local_institution.primary: School CTE health sciences + local clinic / CHW partners + community college nursing/allied

pilot_geography.rule: Prefer HPSA-overlapping rural geography co-located with magnet hub pilot

ownership_model.near_term: Public education + clinical partners; not a privatized care gate

candidates: do-not-claim HPSA closure without measurement design

known_research_items: Scope of practice for CHW pathways

pilot.definition: Allied/primary pathway cohort — explicitly not a claim to replace medical school capacity

failure_conditions: Claiming capture or system proof from HPSA dials
Promising physician supply from CTE alone

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW.explanation: CTE health and allied certificates can start under existing education/clinical partnership authorities. Expanding medical school seats or residencies is a different packet and may require capital/legislation.
